blocks.text: Ping command network connectivity (jurne ki halat) test karne ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh check karti hai ke koi device network par reachable (pohanch mein) hai ya nahi. Ping doosre device ko chhote data packets bhejti hai (jaise Figure 1.16 mein). Yeh destination (manzil) se response time (jawab aane ka waqt) napti hai. Yeh command network delays (deri) pakarne mein madad deti hai. Internet connection check karne ke liye yeh aam istemal hoti hai.

Pinging google.com [142.250.190.14] with 32 bytes of data:
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=24ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=26ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh Windows ki command hai, Python program nahi; ise command prompt mein likha jata hai.
"C:\> ping google.com": "C:\>" command prompt ka nishan hai; "ping google.com" google.com ko packets bhejne ka hukum hai.
"Pinging google.com [142.250.190.14] with 32 bytes of data:": DNS ne naam ko IP address 142.250.190.14 mein badla, aur har packet 32 bytes ka hai.
"Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118": jawab aaya; 32 bytes wapas aaye; aane jane mein 25 milliseconds lage; TTL (time to live: packet zyada se zyada kitne routers se guzar sakta hai) 118 bacha.
Chaar Reply lines: Windows chaar packets bhejta hai; waqt 25, 24, 26 aur 25 ms hain, yani connection achha hai. "Request timed out" aaye to matlab jawab wapas nahi aaya.
Output: Sample Output wali paanch lines (ek "Pinging..." aur chaar "Reply from..."); asal output aap ke internet ke hisaab se thora mukhtalif hoga.

blocks.alt: Host A, laptop jis ki screen par Ping 192.168.0.1 likha hai, aur Host B, server. ICMP Echo Request ka teer Host A se Host B tak jata hai, aur ICMP Echo Reply ka teer Host B se wapas Host A tak aata hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Do jaghon (locations) ke darmiyan packets ke raaste ka naqsha banayein.
Ping ke aakhir mein Windows minimum, maximum aur average waqt bhi batata hai. Yeh program Sample Output ke chaar waqton se yahi hisaab lagata hai. times_ms badal kar Run karein.

times_ms = [25, 24, 26, 25]

print(f"Packets: Sent = {len(times_ms)}, Received = {len(times_ms)}")
print(f"Minimum = {min(times_ms)}ms, Maximum = {max(times_ms)}ms")
print(f"Average = {sum(times_ms) / len(times_ms)}ms")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"times_ms = [25, 24, 26, 25]": Sample Output ki chaar Reply lines ke waqt (milliseconds).
"len(times_ms)": list mein kitne waqt hain = 4, yani 4 packets gaye aur 4 aaye.
"min(times_ms)" sab se chhota (24) aur "max(times_ms)" sab se bara (26) waqt deta hai.
"sum(times_ms) / len(times_ms)": (25 + 24 + 26 + 25) / 4 = 100 / 4 = 25.0; "/" hamesha decimal number deta hai.
f"..." (f-string) mein { } ke andar ki value text mein aa jati hai.
Output: "Packets: Sent = 4, Received = 4", "Minimum = 24ms, Maximum = 26ms", "Average = 25.0ms".
Khud try karein: times_ms = [20, 120, 25, 35] kar ke Run karein: Average = 50.0ms aur Maximum = 120ms; ek packet mein bohat deri hui, yeh latency ka masla dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ping command kya check karti hai, aur Reply line mein "time=25ms" ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh check karti hai ke device network par pohanch mein hai aur jawab kitni der mein aata hai. time=25ms ka matlab packet ke jane aur jawab wapas aane mein 25 milliseconds lage.

items: ping: packets bhej kar device tak pohanch aur response time check; Reply line mein bytes, time aur TTL; deri pakarne ke liye.
